text: Hm. Another one fresh off the road, by the look of those boots.
Rope, torches, bread, potions. Things that keep you breathing down a hole. You pay in coin, same as the Guild pays you. No credit, no haggling.
{player}. Still in one piece, I see. What'll it be?
B-rank. Eleven years. Lost the eye in a gate the Guild marked C. It was no C. Lost the party with it.
The tag's cracked, same as me. Now I sell the rope to the ones who still go down. Better business. Fewer funerals.
Always carry more light than you think. Never fight on an empty belly.
And if a gate goes quiet, it's not empty. It's waiting. Bring me what you strip off the dead; I'll pay fair.
